purpose: Teach: 結び付け/可変/一望/財務諸表/苦心/降格/行きつけ/委嘱

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の頑張りを評価に結び付けましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're tying staff effort directly to their evaluations.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Professional but approachable. Even pace, forward momentum. No hesitation — this is a clear directive, not a question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。可変料金プランをホームページに掲載しました
lines.en: Done. I've got the variable pricing plan up on the website.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Brief pause after the opening word — 'I've got this handled.' Steady eye contact. Quiet competence, no need to overstate.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新店舗から海が一望できると人気が出そうですね
lines.en: The sea view from the new location should really draw people in.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly lighter in tone. A small lift of optimism on 'should really draw.' Conversational pace. She's thinking out loud, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への財務諸表説明会を設定しました
lines.en: I've set up the financial briefing with our key clients.
lines.style: Straightforward delivery. Factual, quick. No elaboration needed — the work is done. Slight professional distance, but warm underneath.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 苦心して開発した新製品を発表しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we launch the new product — we put real work into developing it.
lines.style: Thoughtful weight on 'real work.' Slower than the first directive. This one matters to her — there's care in how she phrases it. Not pushy, but firm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内で降格の手続きを学ぶ研修を実施します
lines.en: Got it. I'll set up training on the transition procedures.
lines.style: Clear, practical. Quick acknowledgment. Neutral tone — this is procedural work, not emotionally charged. Efficient clip to the delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様の行きつけのカフェを把握しましょう
lines.en: Let's find out where our key clients like to spend their time — their regular haunts.
lines.style: Curious, almost gentle directive. Slower pace than the first one. A sense of wanting to know people better, not just manage them. Slight warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。専門家に調査を委嘱します
lines.en: I'll bring in a specialist to handle the research.
lines.style: Calm, assured closing. No rush. Delegation as reassurance — 'this is in good hands.' Warm finality. Slight breath ease at the end.
